messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for synthetic check 'canary-apac-01' -> severity P1. Trigger: 3 consecutive failures (504/502). Link: https://pd.redwood.example/INC-987654 

pagerduty: Incident INC-987654 created: synthetic-checks / canary-runner in apac-northeast-1. Escalation: oncall@sre -> rotation #3.

aj: acked INC-987654 and taking initial triage. I'm at my desk, starting with probe logs.

maria: oncall here, i'm pulling canary logs and backend pool health. tagging @sophie in case of customer impact.

sophie: seeing spike in latency for apac region - dashboards show 5xx burst starting ~1934567850. Canaries are tripping every 30s. No other regions affected.

aj: running quick curl against canary endpoint: `curl -v https://canary-apac-01.redwood.io/healthz` -> returns 502, upstream: "Bad Gateway"

maria: backend pool apac-pool-3 showing high connection errors and increased CPU on instance i-apac-03. Suspect a bad node or overloaded gateway.

aj: I'm going to pause synthetic checks in APAC to stop paging noise: `kubectl -n canary patch config canary-config --type merge -p '{"regions":{"apac":false}}'`

incident-bot: Synthetic checks paused for apac region by aj. PagerDuty note appended.

henry: Can we route traffic away from apac-pool-3 while we investigate? If it's a load balancer rule, we can drain it.

maria: initiating drain now: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-health-checks --target-group-arn arn:aws:... --healthy-threshold-count 2` then `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:... --targets Id=i-apac-03`

maria: deregister command returned SUCCESS. Starting to monitor.

sophie: after drain, canary failures reduced to 2 failures in last 5m (was 12). latency p95 for apac down from 1.2s to 220ms.

aj: great. Re-enabled canaries in apac (briefly) to validate: `kubectl -n canary patch ... apac:true`

incident-bot: Synthetic check resumed; next runs in 30s.

maria: canary run at +30s returned OK. All monitors green. Errors at peak were ~0.5% of APAC requests, small but visible on dashboards. No customer tickets opened yet.

henry: I'm taking the incident for follow-up and postmortem. Will create INC-987654 follow-up doc and assign to eng-runtime + infra. Planning a runbook entry: add automatic drain/telemetry for pool-level overloads.

aj: ack. Handoff in 30m to henry for postmortem and next steps. Leaving the incident open for the 30m verification window. :thumbsup:

sophie: customer-impact note for the follow-up: "Transient 502s from apac-pool-3 caused canary failures; routed traffic away and drained target; <0.5% of apac requests affected; no major customers reported errors."

maria: saved logs and commands in incident channel Gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcdef. Will attach to the postmortem.

henry: created follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-2345 - assigned to eng-runtime for deeper investigation and runbook update. I'll close the PD when postmortem is scheduled.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-987654 acknowledged by aj and assigned to henry for post-incident follow-up.

aj: closing note: mitigation worked, monitoring stable for 15m, keeping page open until 30m window expires. If anything flares, @henry will escalate.

henry: taking over now. Good triage team. I'll coordinate the retro. :100:
